capabilities: download Bilibili videos from links, short links, watch-later lists, or BV ids
fetch CC and AI subtitles with cc/auto/ai preference
transcribe local videos with whisper and export txt/srt/json
segment subtitles into standardized note entries
manage a serial task queue with progress, cancellation, and retry
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not clip or trim video files; it produces subtitle text notes from videos.
extras: macOS-first (Apple Metal whisper acceleration); installed via BRAT or manually; manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff; MIT licensed; deliberately excludes LLM-dependent features like speaker labeling and translation to keep its zero-cloud promise.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn video content, specifically Bilibili videos, into subtitle-based notes, and doing so usually requires cloud APIs or manual transcription.

relations.evidence: Built-in environment check (python3 / yt-dlp / ffmpeg / whisper-cli / model)

summary: Turns Bilibili videos into structured subtitle notes with a one-command local pipeline: download, subtitle fetch or whisper transcription, and sentence segmentation.
